The date step originally used a non-focusable div, preventing keyboard users from reaching the date field. After making it an input, keyboard users can type a date, but the onMonthChange handler (triggered when the typed date changes the month) overrides the user's choice with the first available day of the month. We preserve the user's typed date by storing it on change and restoring it after getUnavailableDates runs.

When a user types a date that changes the month, the onMonthChange handler triggers getUnavailableDates which then overrides the user's selected date with the first available day of the month. We preserve the user's typed date by capturing it on keyup (user input) and restoring it after getUnavailableDates runs, ignoring programmatic changes.
